failures.evidence: Run 7-r4-block at 2b7369f4: `dispatch ask --issue INFRA-465 --advisor-rebuttal 'first reason' --question '…' --advisor-rebuttal 'second reason'` was recorded as `dispatch ask --issue INFRA-465 --question '…' # --advisor-rebuttal 'second reason'`, and the acknowledgement names only 'second reason'. The first flag is gone from the command, the note and the entry. The agent wrote xd://report_issue: 'Recorded command dropped 'first reason' entirely with no mention'.
